classification: Independent exploratory waveform inversion using generic gCAP/FK; no synthetic observations
source_depth: Own bsl depth +0.5 km; reference free surface at -0.5 km bsl
receiver_depth: Flat model surface; topographic receiver correction not implemented
rho: FK documented fallback rho=0.77+0.32 Vp in g/cm3
Q: FK defaults Qs=500 Qp=1000; not measured here
filter: Both data and Green functions prefiltered 0.2–2 Hz, 4-pole zero-phase, then 20 Hz. Different ordering from stock gCAP segment filtering; exploratory assumption.
windows: Own P-.3 to P+1.2; own S-.3 to S+4.7 s; maximum shifts .5 and 1 s; Pnl weight 2 and distance powers 1/.5; no automatic trace rejection
source: Fixed own provisional location/depth, DC only, 10-degree strike/dip/rake grid, Mw step .1, 0.2-s trapezoidal duration. Settings are generic/disclosed, not recovered Tan event controls.
rotation: Metadata-verified ZNE -> upward Z, outward radial R, counterclockwise T; cm/s; horizontal energy check passed for saved records
validation: Finite Green functions and fit arrays; counts; rotation energy; eigensolver consistency. No model/path or source-depth sensitivity acceptance. Raw variance reduction is not a validation of source mechanism.
software: Official FK 3.3 and generic Zhu gCAP, with disclosed cap_followup eigensolver/external-filter port; archive/extraction manifests in inputs/method_followup/
